purpose: Presentation contract, NOT authoritative game configuration and NOT assets/catalog.json.

observed_repo_topology.instruction: Verify current branch; preserve all actual cells. No gameplay change is authorized by this asset pack.

projection.offset_coordinates: odd-r (odd row shifted right by half hex width)
projection.global_center: subtract the same ArenaCenter from every world layer
projection.warning: Do not use a sector bounding-box width as pitch; it includes the half-column stagger. Never restart parity at a seam.

layered_mode.ground: Map each matching 1024-square variant to its sector-wide ground rectangle; extend terrain beyond outer half-cell stagger and beneath endcaps.
layered_mode.backgrounds: Uniform scale pitch/1024; bottom fade overlaps the ground outside the active field.
layered_mode.foreground: Uniform scale pitch/1024; keep dense objects outside the global last playable row.
layered_mode.endcaps: Exactly two total, outside global left/right board bounds; overlay continued base art, never black gutters. Not extra sectors.
layered_mode.boundary_selection: Geometry, highlight, ownership and picking come from live cells, not PNG art.

assembled_mode.warning: Do not stack these on the layered mode; they already include ground, backdrop and foreground. For another projection use layered mode.

structure_suggestions.Watchpost: Retain existing visual/fallback, or explicitly reuse tower cosmetically with clear kind label.
structure_suggestions.CatapultTower: Retain existing catapult art/fallback. Do not mislabel the supplied arrow tower as a separate catapult design.
structure_suggestions.note: World footprints, life bars, state, targeting and ownership remain authoritative. Painted banner colors are decorative, not faction data.

drawing_order: structures and units in one ground-depth order
memory_note: 19 runtime PNGs total; loading every variant, all optional plates, and all FX uncompressed is about 50 MiB before overhead/mipmaps. Load one presentation route and share textures.
